title: The Detention of the water tower
author: Tamsin Yarrow
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
